title: Popover inside a popover
description:
Layout-quality rule — a popover button is placed inside another popover panel. Nested popovers do not work reliably in FileMaker; opening the inner popover closes the outer one.

Based on the fmCheckMate check "Popover in popover" — https://github.com/mrwatson-de/fmCheckMate-XSLT
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: FileMaker does not support opening a popover from inside another popover — the outer popover closes when the inner one opens, so the UI flow breaks.
rule.remediation: Move the inner popover button outside the popover panel, or replace it with a card window or a separate panel.
